blocking_failures: behavior_in_tests: The instruction requires broader behavior than the supplied tests verify, including extensive platform/variant closure cases, event permutations, locale and mtime invariance, and more generated graph/history cases; the visible test file covers only a smaller fixed subset.

deterministic_tests: test_canonical_fields_and_large_fixture asserts completion under six wall-clock seconds, so a correct implementation can fail because of host scheduling or resource contention; this is not deterministic solely from the solution.
valid_failure_modes: The fixed six-second subprocess timing assertion creates an invalid environment-dependent failure mode unrelated to semantic correctness.
advice: pinned_dependencies: Although uv and pytest are version-pinned, the Dockerfile uses the floating python:3.13-slim-bookworm base tag rather than an immutable Python patch-level image digest, so the full external dependency environment is not adequately pinned.

test_deps_in_image: The Dockerfile runs uvx --from pytest==8.4.1 during image construction, baking the test-only pytest dependency and its cache into the runtime image instead of isolating it to tests/test.sh.
